title: Pixel art, 16-bit era
description: Richer pixel art with a larger palette, shaded outlines and careful dithering, like 16-bit era games.

art_style.outline_policy: One-pixel outline in a darker shade of the fill colour; selective outlining allowed on lit edges.
art_style.shading_policy: Three to five tones per material with hue-shifted shadows and highlights; dithering allowed in small areas.
art_style.texture_policy: Small repeating patterns and light noise at pixel scale.
art_style.pixel_density: One art pixel is one game pixel; tiles 16 to 32 px, characters 16 to 48 px tall.
art_style.palette_reference: A fixed palette of at most 64 colours, chosen once for the whole game.

native_size_guidance: Draw at the final pixel size: tiles of 16 or 32 px and characters one to two tiles tall. Never draw large and shrink.
avoid: Do not use anti-aliasing, blur or soft gradients.
Do not draw detail finer than one art pixel.
Do not mix pixel sizes: every art pixel is the same size across the whole image.
Do not add colours outside the fixed palette of 64.
